panels.title: Cell ID / Kit ID 추적
panels.description: 상단에 전체 ID를 입력합니다. 두 ID를 넣으면 양쪽의 이력을 함께 보여 줍니다. 최신 300건이며 화면 시간 범위는 적용하지 않습니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.purpose, r.started_at, r.ended_at
  FROM sim_run r
  WHERE r.line = '2A'
    AND (NULLIF(btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}), '') IS NULL OR r.run_id::text = btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}))
  ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
input AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(btrim(${cell_id:sqlstring}), '') AS cell_id,
         NULLIF(btrim(${kit_id:sqlstring}), '') AS kit_id
), hits AS (
  SELECT c.cell_id, c.box_id, c.box_slot, c.grade, c.status, c.lot_code, c.created_at
  FROM selected_run r JOIN cell c ON c.run_id = r.run_id
  CROSS JOIN input p
  WHERE c.cell_id = p.cell_id OR c.box_id = p.kit_id
), hit_boxes AS (
  SELECT b.box_id, b.grade, b.status, b.opened_at, b.packed_at
  FROM selected_run r JOIN cell_box b ON b.run_id = r.run_id
  CROSS JOIN input p
  WHERE b.box_id = p.kit_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits c WHERE c.box_id = b.box_id)
), history AS (
  SELECT c.created_at AS stamp, NULL::bigint AS event_order, c.cell_id AS ref,
         '셀 등록'::text AS event, c.cell_id, c.box_id AS kit_id, NULL::text AS station,
         concat_ws(' · ', '현재 ' || c.status, 'LOT ' || c.lot_code,
                   '특성군 ' || c.grade, '슬롯 ' || c.box_slot) AS detail
  FROM hits c
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.measured_at, i.id, i.id::text, i.kind, c.cell_id, c.box_id, i.station_code,
         concat_ws(' · ', '시도 ' || i.attempt,
           CASE WHEN i.result_code IN (0,1,2,3) THEN 'PASS'
                WHEN i.result_code = 9 THEN 'FAIL'
                WHEN i.result_code = 5 AND i.kind = 'electrical' THEN '대기'
                WHEN i.result_code = 5 THEN '미판독' END,
           '사유 ' || i.reason_code, round(i.ocv_mv / 1000.0, 3)::text || ' V',
           i.ir_mohm::text || ' mΩ')
  FROM hits c JOIN cell_inspection i ON i.cell_id = c.cell_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.occurred_at, NULL, e.event_id::text, e.event_type,
         c.cell_id, COALESCE(b.box_id, c.box_id), e.station_code, '공정 이벤트 원장'
  FROM selected_run r JOIN event_log e ON e.run_id = r.run_id AND e.source = '2A'
  LEFT JOIN hits c ON c.cell_id = e.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN hit_boxes b ON b.box_id = e.entity_id
  WHERE c.cell_id IS NOT NULL OR b.box_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(b.packed_at, b.opened_at), NULL, b.box_id, 'Kit 기록',
         NULL, b.box_id, NULL, '특성군 ' || b.grade || ' · 현재 상태 ' || b.status
  FROM hit_boxes b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT h.stamp, NULL, sh.request_id, h.event, NULL, b.box_id, NULL,
         '요청 라인 ' || sh.requested_by || ' · 현재 상태 ' || sh.status
  FROM hit_boxes b JOIN supply_handoff sh ON sh.box_id = b.box_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('인계 요청', sh.requested_at), ('출구 통과', sh.released_at),
                            ('수신 확인', sh.confirmed_at)) h(event, stamp)
  WHERE h.stamp IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT stamp AS "발생 시각", event AS "이벤트", ref AS "원본 ID", cell_id AS "Cell ID",
       kit_id AS "Kit ID", station AS "스테이션", detail AS "상세"
FROM history ORDER BY stamp DESC, event_order DESC NULLS LAST, ref DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: LOT 검색 · 구성 셀
panels.description: LOT 코드를 입력하면 선택 회차에 속한 Cell ID와 Kit ID를 보여줍니다. 최대 200개.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT run_id, ended_at FROM sim_run WHERE line = '2A'
    AND (NULLIF(btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}), '') IS NULL OR run_id::text = btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}))
  ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT 1
)

SELECT c.lot_code AS "LOT", c.cell_id AS "Cell ID", c.status AS "셀 상태",
       c.grade AS "특성군", c.box_id AS "Kit ID", c.box_slot AS "슬롯", c.created_at AS "등록 시각"
FROM selected_run r JOIN cell c USING (run_id)
WHERE c.lot_code = NULLIF(btrim(${lot_code:sqlstring}), '')
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.cell_id LIMIT 200

panels.title: Kit 슬롯 · 편차 · 인계 기록
panels.description: 선택 기간의 최근 Kit 200건. 슬롯, 특성군 일치, 편차와 최신 인계 요청 상태를 조회합니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.purpose, r.started_at, r.ended_at
  FROM sim_run r
  WHERE r.line = '2A'
    AND (NULLIF(btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}), '') IS NULL OR r.run_id::text = btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}))
  ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
boxes AS (
  SELECT b.box_id, b.grade, b.status, b.run_id, b.packed_at, b.cells, b.spread_mv
  FROM selected_run r JOIN v_box_spread b ON b.run_id = r.run_id
  JOIN cell_box raw ON raw.box_id = b.box_id
  WHERE COALESCE(b.packed_at, raw.opened_at) >= $__timeFrom()
    AND COALESCE(b.packed_at, raw.opened_at) < $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY COALESCE(b.packed_at, raw.opened_at) DESC, b.box_id
  LIMIT 200
)
SELECT b.box_id AS "Kit ID", b.grade AS "특성군", b.status AS "DB 상태", b.packed_at AS "완료 시각",
       b.cells AS "구성 셀",
       max(c.cell_id) FILTER (WHERE c.box_slot = 1) AS "슬롯 1",
       max(c.cell_id) FILTER (WHERE c.box_slot = 2) AS "슬롯 2",
       max(c.cell_id) FILTER (WHERE c.box_slot = 3) AS "슬롯 3",
       max(c.cell_id) FILTER (WHERE c.box_slot = 4) AS "슬롯 4",
       CASE WHEN b.status = 'filling' THEN '적재 중'
            WHEN b.cells = 4 AND b.packed_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND count(DISTINCT c.box_slot) = 4
                 AND bool_and(c.grade IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.grade AND c.run_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.run_id)
              THEN '동일 특성군 4셀'
            ELSE '구성 확인 필요' END AS "구성 확인",
       (b.spread_mv / 1000.0)::double precision AS "OCV 편차 (V)",
       h.status AS "최신 인계 상태", h.requested_at AS "인계 요청",
       h.released_at AS "출구 통과", h.confirmed_at AS "수신 확인"
FROM boxes b
LEFT JOIN cell c ON c.box_id = b.box_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sh.status, sh.requested_at, sh.released_at, sh.confirmed_at
  FROM supply_handoff sh WHERE sh.box_id = b.box_id
  ORDER BY sh.requested_at DESC, sh.request_id DESC LIMIT 1
) h ON true
GROUP BY b.box_id, b.grade, b.status, b.run_id, b.packed_at, b.cells, b.spread_mv,
         h.status, h.requested_at, h.released_at, h.confirmed_at
ORDER BY b.packed_at DESC NULLS LAST, b.box_id

panels.title: 전기검사 원본 기록
panels.description: 선택 기간의 최근 500건입니다. 같은 시각의 검사 결과도 검사 ID와 시도로 구분합니다. Cell ID를 입력하면 해당 셀만 조회합니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.purpose, r.started_at, r.ended_at
  FROM sim_run r
  WHERE r.line = '2A'
    AND (NULLIF(btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}), '') IS NULL OR r.run_id::text = btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}))
  ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
observations AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.measured_at, i.cell_id, i.station_code, i.attempt, i.ocv_mv, i.ir_mohm,
         i.result_code, i.reason_code
  FROM selected_run r
  JOIN cell c ON c.run_id = r.run_id
  JOIN cell_inspection i ON i.cell_id = c.cell_id
  WHERE i.kind = 'electrical'
    AND i.measured_at >= $__timeFrom() AND i.measured_at < $__timeTo()
    AND (NULLIF(btrim(${cell_id:sqlstring}), '') IS NULL OR c.cell_id = btrim(${cell_id:sqlstring}))
  ORDER BY i.measured_at DESC, i.id DESC
  LIMIT 500
)
SELECT measured_at AS "time", id::text AS "검사 ID", cell_id AS "Cell ID",
       station_code AS "검사기", attempt AS "시도",
       (ocv_mv / 1000.0)::double precision AS "OCV (V)", ir_mohm AS "IR (mΩ)",
       CASE WHEN result_code IN (1,2,3) THEN 'PASS' WHEN result_code = 5 THEN '대기'
            WHEN result_code = 9 THEN 'FAIL' END AS "시도 결과",
       reason_code AS "사유 코드",
       CASE result_code WHEN 1 THEN 'A' WHEN 2 THEN 'B' WHEN 3 THEN 'C' END AS "전기 특성군"
FROM observations
ORDER BY measured_at, id

panels.title: 최근 공정 이벤트
panels.description: 선택 회차와 공정 발생 시간 범위의 2A 이벤트 최근 100건입니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.purpose, r.started_at, r.ended_at
  FROM sim_run r
  WHERE r.line = '2A'
    AND (NULLIF(btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}), '') IS NULL OR r.run_id::text = btrim(${run_id:sqlstring}))
  ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
station_state AS (
  SELECT s.station_code, s.name, s.kind, s.sort_order, e.state, e.started_at, e.ended_at, t.seconds
  FROM station s
  LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT es.state, es.started_at, es.ended_at
    FROM equipment_state es
    WHERE es.station_code = s.station_code AND es.run_id = r.run_id
    ORDER BY es.started_at DESC, es.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) e ON true
  LEFT JOIN v_equipment_time t
    ON t.station_code = s.station_code AND t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.state = e.state
  WHERE s.line = '2A'
), run_lots AS (
  SELECT c.lot_code, count(*) AS cells
  FROM cell c JOIN selected_run r ON r.run_id = c.run_id
  GROUP BY c.lot_code
), visible_alarms AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.station_code, a.code, a.severity, a.raised_at, a.acked_at, a.message
  FROM v_alarm_open a
  LEFT JOIN station s ON s.station_code = a.station_code
  LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  WHERE a.run_id = r.run_id OR (a.run_id IS NULL AND s.line = '2A')
), latest_event AS (
  SELECT e.occurred_at, e.received_at, e.station_code, e.event_type
  FROM selected_run r JOIN event_log e ON e.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE e.source = '2A'
  ORDER BY e.received_at DESC, e.event_id DESC LIMIT 1
), recent_events AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.occurred_at, e.received_at, e.station_code, e.event_type, e.entity_id
  FROM selected_run r JOIN event_log e ON e.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE e.source = '2A'
    AND e.occurred_at >= $__timeFrom() AND e.occurred_at < $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.event_id DESC LIMIT 100
), state_history AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.station_code, e.state, e.started_at, e.ended_at
  FROM selected_run r JOIN equipment_state e ON e.run_id = r.run_id
  JOIN station s ON s.station_code = e.station_code AND s.line = '2A'
  WHERE e.started_at < $__timeTo()
    AND COALESCE(e.ended_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > $__timeFrom()
  ORDER BY e.started_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 100
), rows AS (
  SELECT 'overview' AS section, -1 AS position, '선택 실행'::text AS item,
         COALESCE(r.run_id::text, '미수집 / 회차 없음') AS state,
         r.started_at AS started, r.ended_at AS ended,
         NULL::numeric AS amount, r.purpose AS detail
  FROM (VALUES (1)) AS anchor(n) LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'overview', s.sort_order, s.station_code || ' · ' || s.name,
         CASE WHEN s.state IS NULL THEN '미수집'
              WHEN s.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN s.state || ' · 종료'
              ELSE s.state END,
         s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.seconds, s.kind
  FROM station_state s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'lot', 0, l.lot_code, CASE WHEN l.is_held THEN '보류' ELSE '보류 아님' END,
         l.last_held_at, NULL, x.cells,
         format('공용 DB 셀 %s · 최신 전기 NG %s', l.cells, l.confirmed_ng)
  FROM v_lot_status l LEFT JOIN run_lots x USING (lot_code)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'alarm', -a.severity, COALESCE(a.station_code, '회차 공통') || ' · ' || a.code,
         CASE WHEN a.acked_at IS NULL THEN '미확인' ELSE '확인됨' END,
         a.raised_at, a.acked_at, a.severity,
         '#' || a.id::text || COALESCE(' · ' || a.message, '')
  FROM visible_alarms a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'freshness', 0, COALESCE('회차 ' || r.run_id::text, '선택 실행 없음'),
         CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL THEN '미수집 · 회차 없음'
              WHEN r.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN '회차 종료'
              WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_alarms a WHERE a.code = 'COMM_LOST')
                THEN '수집 통신 장애 · 열린 알람'
              WHEN e.received_at IS NULL THEN '미수집 · 이벤트 없음'
              WHEN e.received_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR e.occurred_at > e.received_at
                THEN '시계 확인 필요'
              WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - e.received_at > interval '30 seconds'
                THEN '이벤트 유입 지연 · 연결 미확인'
              ELSE '최근 수신 있음' END,
         e.received_at, e.occurred_at,
         CASE WHEN r.ended_at IS NULL AND e.received_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              THEN floor(extract(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - e.received_at)) END,
         CASE WHEN e.received_at IS NOT NULL THEN
           concat_ws(' · ', e.station_code, e.event_type,
             CASE WHEN e.occurred_at <= e.received_at
                  THEN '발생→DB ' || round(extract(epoch FROM e.received_at - e.occurred_at), 1)::text || '초' END)
         END
  FROM (VALUES (1)) AS anchor(n)
  LEFT JOIN selected_run r ON true
  LEFT JOIN latest_event e ON true
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'events', 0, e.station_code, e.event_type, e.occurred_at, e.received_at,
         CASE WHEN e.occurred_at <= e.received_at
              THEN round(extract(epoch FROM e.received_at - e.occurred_at), 1) END,
         concat_ws(' · ', e.entity_id, e.event_id::text)
  FROM recent_events e
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'state_history', 0, e.station_code, e.state, e.started_at, e.ended_at,
         floor(extract(epoch FROM COALESCE(e.ended_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - e.started_at)),
         e.id::text
  FROM state_history e
)
SELECT section AS "영역", item AS "항목", state AS "상태", started AS "시각",
       ended AS "종료·확인 시각", amount AS "값", detail AS "상세"
FROM rows
ORDER BY section, position, CASE WHEN section IN ('alarm','events','state_history') THEN started END DESC NULLS LAST, item, detail

panels.title: 설비 상태 변경 이력
panels.description: 선택 구간과 겹치는 상태 전이 최근 100건입니다. 종료가 미수집이면 열린 상태 구간입니다.

panels.title: LOT 보류 현황
panels.description: 보류와 상세 NG 값은 공용 DB 전체의 현재 상태입니다. 선택 회차 셀 수는 별도 열입니다.
